rows.description: A student who decides to fix sleep and study schedules and records the progress feels increased confidence; visible results teach that they are the author of some outcomes.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17

rows.subtype: Everything is luck or teacher's mood [Actor]
rows.description: A child with an external locus says the teacher gave low marks and never links results with preparation; belief that outcomes come from outside reduces effort.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A teenager with a strongly internal view blames themselves for family conflict or a friend's bad choices; too much perceived control turns into guilt.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 18–22, 23–26

rows.subtype: Balanced view of luck and effort [Response]
rows.description: A student recognises that both effort and chance shaped a result, such as a good school or a hard exam paper, and acts on the parts they can influence; balance avoids both blame and helplessness.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 23–26

rows.description: A person from a culture where fate and karma are central notices that they can trust destiny and still work hard; beliefs in larger forces need not cancel personal responsibility.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: An adult who says the boss, the market and luck are always against them never examines their own share; a fully external view protects pride but blocks learning.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: A child who is repeatedly told they are so clever begins to avoid hard problems in order to keep that label; praise of traits can make risk feel dangerous.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A teacher who points out that the child kept trying different methods and it paid off teaches that ability grows with effort; specific process praise supports challenge seeking.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A teenager who is weak at drawing says they are just not creative and stops; the belief turns a current level into a permanent limit.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A student who sees a peer excel decides the gap is destiny and feels threatened rather than inspired; a fixed view makes others' success feel like personal loss.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 23–26
